questions.question: How should capture.mjs handle a log file that gets very large?

options.label: Rotate at 10 MB
options.description: Rename the file to ask-capture.1.jsonl once it passes 10 MB, then start a new one.

options.label: Daily files
options.description: Write to a new file each day, such as ask-capture-2026-11-20.jsonl.
